edition_policy: Only current and fixed legacy remain visible. No intermediate profile or new old-spelling aliases.

rationale.mikrob: User adopted 微生物: restore the historically recorded broad microorganism meaning; 微/生/物 each contribute and are already shared characters. Preserve annotations and root boundaries.
rationale.mikrobicid: Propagate the adopted mikrob display into the existing mikrob/cid family, retaining 杀 and the established identifier policy.
rationale.mikrobologi: Propagate the adopted mikrob display into the existing mikrob/logi family, retaining 学ᴸᴳ. This is distinct from mikrobiologi=mikro/bio/logi.
rationale.diafragm: User adopted 隔膜: 隔 contributes separation and 膜 membrane, sharing existing characters while preserving the broad anatomical, botanical, acoustic and optical annotations.
